ios.desc:
Feed Brew provides an easy to use interface to build your own content feed. With tons of sources to connect too, Feed brew is more than just a RSS reader

The internet is overflowing with information, and it can be overwhelming to keep up with all the latest news, trends, and topics that interest you. With our app, you can consolidate all your favorite sources into one convenient location, making it easier than ever to stay informed and up-to-date.

Whether you're a news junkie, a social media addict, or a curious learner, our content feed builder has everything you need to create a personalized information hub. Choose from a vast array of sources, including your favorite websites, blogs, social media accounts, podcasts, and more, and our app will bring all the latest updates straight to you.

But what sets our app apart is its powerful customization features. With just a few taps, you can filter out unwanted content, prioritize the sources that matter most to you, and even create custom feeds for specific topics or interests. Our app learns your preferences over time, delivering only the most relevant and engaging content straight to your fingertips.

So why settle for an information overload when you can have a personalized content feed that's tailored to your interests? Download our iOS app today and experience the power of streamlined, curated content.



---

COMPATIBILITY
Sign up required to create any feed.


SUPPORT
